District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 22-C in the area bounded by

13.   Describe the proposed use ofthe property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of

      approximately 2.300 sq. ft. of floor area, each home will measure 27 ft. in height, and each
      home will be supported by a new tw^o (2) car garage located at the rear ofthe property.
